top_issues: Empty state leaves over 65% of the viewport completely blank below primary actions, dampening visceral product appeal.
Color breakdown dots (On-chain, Reserve, Secured, At risk) all display '$0.00' without visual hierarchy or explanation of what 'Secured' vs 'At risk' means to a newcomer.
The micro-label '1 px = $10 · auto' appears floating on the right of BALANCES with zero introductory context for users unfamiliar with the absolute bar scale.
fixes: Add a guided first-action card or interactive deposit onboarding flow directly in the empty BALANCES canvas area.
Include an inline tooltip or subtle descriptor under balance categories distinguishing on-chain escrow from counterparty credit risk.
Relocate the scale indicator '1 px = $10' adjacent to an explicit inactive ruler preview bar.

top_issues: The prominent QR code sits in high-contrast solid white against dark slate without rounded corners or padding, creating severe visual harshness.
Warning banner 'No inbound room yet. Extend a credit line to a hub...' appears at the very bottom in low contrast, despite being a hard operational blocker for receiving funds.
The Entity ID string in 'YOUR ENTITY ID' card is a raw 66-character hex string with small monospace text that is difficult to visually verify.
fixes: Style the QR code container with softened rounded inner corners and a subtle muted border to integrate into desktop-dark.
Elevate the 'No inbound room yet' warning state directly beneath the Amount input or provide an immediate 1-click CTA button to open inbound credit.
Format the Entity ID with visual 4-character chunking and an explicit copy feedback badge.

top_issues: Unrendered raw development string 'MARKET_WIRE_JSON_REQUIRED' in the order book card destroys user trust and looks broken.
Order book status shows yellow 'syncing' indefinitely without a skeleton loader, ticker depth chart, or last trade price.
No exchange rate, slippage tolerance, routing path, or estimated fee breakdown is shown between paying 100 USDC and receiving WETH.
fixes: Replace raw debug text 'MARKET_WIRE_JSON_REQUIRED' with empty state placeholder rows or animated tabular book skeleton.
Render an explicit exchange rate line (e.g. '1 WETH ≈ 3,420 USDC') and execution price impact preview before the Swap button.
Disable the primary 'Swap' button with an explanatory disabled tooltip when order book feeds are disconnected or unsynced.

top_issues: Extreme negative space occupying roughly 70% of the screen below the 4 top action buttons and sidebar summary card.
The bilateral channel details show 'Frames signed: 0' and 'Status: Open', but fail to display current credit limit, collateral posted, or directional balances.
The explanation paragraph inside 'THIS ACCOUNT' is dense, unformatted small text that blends into the background.
fixes: Display a visual bilateral balance bar (Local balance, Remote balance, Credit line, Enforceable reserve) across the center view.
Break the account parameters into structured data tiles: Your Collateral, Hub Collateral, Credit In, Credit Out.
Fill the lower body with an account-specific frame timeline or audit history log.

top_issues: Master-detail arrangement on wide screen leaves massive empty black canvas between the item list and detail panel.
Detail drawer header displays 'Account opened' with full hub hex '0x23d8a3...21b7' concatenated tightly next to the label 'H1'.
Lack of actionability on selected receipt (no raw JSON export, no shareable proof link, no dispute initiation trigger).
fixes: Constrain list and detail split-pane widths to a unified centered container to eliminate dead black canvas.
Format counterparty addresses cleanly with an icon, tag, and dedicated copy button.
Add 'Export proof bundle' and 'Verify frame signature' CTA buttons directly into the detail pane.

top_issues: Duplicate screen state to 07-activity without additional interaction states, demonstrating repetitive empty viewports.
The frame metadata displays '#7' and timestamp without hash or cryptographic commitment root visible to auditing users.
No visual state indicator for on-chain anchoring vs off-chain bilateral settlement.
fixes: Provide expandable cryptographic proof section showing state Merkle root and dual signatures.
Include quick deep-link to the exact counterparty account inspect page from the activity detail view.
Offer download of signed EIP-712 / frame envelope as JSON.

top_issues: Page length requires deep scrolling with high cognitive density mixing mathematical bar scale settings, design theme tokens, and cryptographic keys.
The preview widget for '$1,284,500.00' is static and non-interactive, which can mislead users into thinking it reflects real balance.
'Forget vault' is placed directly beside 'Lock' and 'Reveal recovery phrase' with minimal safety buffer.
fixes: Segment settings into tabbed navigation: Display & Scale, Channels & Appearance, Security & Vault.
Add explicit 'PREVIEW ONLY' watermark or badge over the balance customization card.
Isolate destructive action 'Forget vault' into a distinct red-bordered Danger Zone at the page base.

top_issues: The 3x2 matrix of source (Wallet, Reserve, Account) and target (Wallet, Reserve, Account) tiles is abstract; the flow direction requires deciphering tiny borders.
Validation error 'Amount exceeds what is available here' is placed below disabled buttons at the bottom edge instead of under the Amount input field.
Side explanation 'Fund you through H1' in WHAT HAPPENS does not explain fees or on-chain transaction gas costs required for the Reserve-to-Account transition.
fixes: Add explicit directional arrows connecting the active Source card directly to the Destination card.
Render the error message 'Amount exceeds what is available here' directly under the Amount input container in red text.
Add estimated L1 gas fee and settlement time in the 'WHAT HAPPENS' card.

top_issues: Six card buttons of uneven conceptual hierarchy (Sovereignty, Move, Assets, Lending, Ownership, Needs Attention) arranged in a sparse 2-column grid.
Right-hand 'ACCOUNTS' pane shows 'H1 hub: 0 lanes · 0 frames · open' with zero financial metrics (liquidity, credit, balance).
Over 60% of lower screen real estate is completely blank.
fixes: Reorganize cards into functional groups: Capital Operations (Move, Assets, Lending) and Governance/Security (Sovereignty, Ownership).
Enrich the Accounts summary item with total collateral held and available routing capacity.
Collapse dead vertical space by adopting a structured dashboard grid.

top_issues: Prominent FAUCETS panel occupies half the screen with four stacked blue primary buttons, giving the UI a test-harness prototype appearance rather than fintech-grade production.
Asset rows repeat 'Depository may pull 0.00' without explaining smart contract approvals or allowance state.
Zero token contract addresses, decimal standards, or direct links to block explorers.
fixes: Move testnet Faucets into an expandable drawer or bottom utility section, prioritizing actual On-Chain & Depository holdings.
Add explicit 'Approve Depository' toggle/status badge alongside token balances.
Provide external explorer links and contract hashes next to Signer and Depository addresses.

top_issues: H1 POOL on the right displays 'Available 0.00, Borrowed 0.00, Active principal 0.00' with zero context on historical yield or default protection.
Token selection input is an empty blank card with no placeholder or selectable dropdown.
Basis point math '= 1.00% per term' lacks annualized APY calculation (e.g. 1% per 1 day vs 1% per 1 month).
fixes: Populate Token selector with selectable assets (e.g., USDC, USDT) and available wallet balances.
Calculate and display effective APY alongside the nominal basis points per term.
Add explicit liquidation and counterparty default guarantees or collateral coverage ratio in the pool summary.

top_issues: Cryptic terminology 'Kind: Lazy (hash of its board)' confuses users without deep internal protocol knowledge.
The 'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY' card is purely passive text with no input field to import or claim an entity.
The screen lacks governance actions: no button to propose new signers, adjust threshold (currently 1 of 1), or register on EntityProvider.
fixes: Add explanatory subtitle for entity types and an active CTA: 'Register on EntityProvider to enable multi-sig'.
Add interactive input for Entity address claim or takeover transfer under the right-hand panel.
Provide explicit 'Add Signer' and 'Change Threshold' action modals.

top_issues: Dispute parameters show 'Can dispute without asking: 0 of 1' without clear next steps or explanation of why co-signing is required or blocked.
'Save evidence bundle' button lacks a visual indicator of bundle size, hash, or format (.json / .zip).
Per-counterparty card displays 'awaiting their signature · no proof yet' in faint text with no manual ping/re-request button.
fixes: Provide a concrete diagnostic state explaining why dispute readiness is 0/1 and what is needed to unlock unilateral dispute.
Display the SHA-256 hash of the evidence bundle directly adjacent to the 'Save evidence bundle' CTA.
Add a 'Request Co-signature' or 'Sync State' action to the counterparty card.

top_issues: Raw error text 'MARKET_WIRE_JSON_REQUIRED' appears again in the right-side order book widget.
Table row contains 'No accounts yet. Open one from Home.' leaving all header columns (POSITION, SECURED, AT RISK, YOU OWE, SEND/RECEIVE, LINES) empty.
Top status shows 'frame #7 · 1 px = $10' without an explanation of whether the table scales visually row by row.
fixes: Fix the market data feed ingestion so the order book displays live bid/ask ladders or clean offline message.
Render populated sample account rows or a comprehensive empty state explaining table columns.
Provide a table toggle to switch between absolute proportional visual bar mode and raw numeric tabular mode.

top_issues: Action shortcuts in the command palette have low-contrast shortcut hints ('send money', 'invoice, QR', 'book at the hub') that blend into dark grey background.
No category grouping (Actions, Navigation, System) in the command palette list.
Selecting entries that require open accounts (e.g., 'Swap', 'Move') lacks status badges indicating readiness.
fixes: Group command palette items into distinct sections: 'Quick Actions', 'Navigation', and 'Security'.
Increase contrast ratio of right-aligned descriptive subtitles to WCAG AA compliance.
Add subtle keyboard navigation shortcuts (e.g. 'P', 'R', 'S') alongside commands.

overall.verdict: The xln desktop wallet exhibits a disciplined, dark aesthetic with exceptional cryptographic rigor in the Sovereignty and Settings views. However, persistent unhandled backend errors in the Swap book and stark empty-state voids across desktop views create severe friction for new and non-technical users.
priority_fixes: Eliminate broken debug artifacts ('MARKET_WIRE_JSON_REQUIRED') in Swap and Desk views by providing clean fallbacks or live order book streams.
Integrate an automated onboarding step on Home and Receive that prompts opening an account and setting inbound credit when balances are zero.
Replace vast expanses of dead space on wide desktop screens (Home, Account, Manage, Activity) with structured summary cards, liquidity depth, and audit logs.
Relocate validation errors (e.g. Move screen balance excess) immediately adjacent to input fields rather than detached below disabled buttons.
Demystify cryptographic jargon ('Lazy board', 'Can dispute without asking: 0 of 1', 'Depository pull') with inline plain-English tooltips and explicit status explanations.
